learnings: Transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) on non-executable metadata files like .SRCINFO or .desktop should not force a global 'inconclusive' verdict if the core PKGBUILD is successfully audited and found safe. The tool should gracefully degrade or override the verdict when the failure is strictly a tooling/LLM parsing issue on benign files.
